name: Shadow Cell Validation 001 v2: Developmental Maturation under Copy-on-Write Functional Isolation
scientific_question: Can new capability be learned outside the accepted model, then selectively admitted without directly mutating mature Cells?
hypothesis: An isolated full-width Shadow Cell with controlled maturity can create a nontrivial plasticity-retention frontier while the accepted model and its read ownership remain immutable.
falsification_rule: If the Task-ID capacity control fails, or if Shadow Oracle cannot satisfy the registered old-regression and new-gain gates at a nontrivial maturity, classify Shadow maturation as not supported; infrastructure violations classify the run as INVALID.

formal_dataset.same_parent_requirement: Every A/B/C/D train, calibration, and evaluation address must have the same complete sparse route tuple.

metrics.new_gain_definition: baseline m=0 NLL minus candidate NLL
metrics.normalized_new_gain_definition: candidate new-domain NLL gain divided by the matched corrected Direct-TX new-domain NLL gain for the same phase
metrics.old_regression_definition: max(0, candidate old NLL minus baseline old NLL)
metrics.plasticity_definition: normalized NLL gain, with answer accuracy retained as a sanity metric
metrics.direct_interp_definition: immutable parent plus m times the realized corrected Direct-TX endpoint delta
metrics.shuffled_gate_definition: same candidate and maturity with gate values deterministically permuted over combined old/new evaluation examples

validity_requirements: canonical checkpoint exists and SHA-256 matches lock
formal dataset exists and SHA-256 matches lock
A/B/C/D share the same mature Parent route
accepted model hash is unchanged during Shadow training
learner historical replay count is zero
B/C/D gate calibration uses phase-specific held-out splits and passes AUC
all required arms and controls complete
absolute final A regression and mean forgetting pass
copy-on-write artifact stores gate, task membership, and parent provenance
notes: This validation does not claim autonomous continual learning, a natural Cell ontology, autonomous mitosis, or a zero-replay global-safety theorem.
A Cell is operationally a versioned candidate functional state; split/mitosis is not required.
The v1 parent directory is present on this branch and is treated as immutable historical evidence.

The Shadow operator learner receives zero historical replay. The bounded functional-sketch selector is an evaluator-side approximation diagnostic and may access registered historical data to construct sufficient statistics. Autonomous replay-free sketch maintenance is outside this validation.
Formal execution remains locked until protocol-lock.json records the canonical checkpoint SHA-256, all formal dataset SHA-256 values, and the implementation manifest hash.
